ai_desc: Connect an OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama, etc.). The API key is stored encrypted and never displayed.
provider_settings_desc: Base URL, model and access credential
test_connection_desc: Verify that the provider responds correctly
test_connection_hint: Sends a minimal message to the configured model to check credentials and connectivity.
test_failed: Could not connect to the provider
validation_url_invalid: Must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL
max_completion_tokens_hint: Per-response token budget (max_tokens). For reasoning models it must be large: thinking and the answer share the budget.
supports_reasoning_hint: Enable if the model exposes thinking (reasoning_content, e.g. deepseek-r1, qwen3). Requires at least 4096 tokens.
validation_max_tokens_reasoning: With reasoning the budget must be at least 4096 tokens
